_SCHEMA_VERSION: program_schema_v4 — updated 2026-04-02. mode values lowercase (full_time, part_time). captured_data changed to flat dict (matching university schema). All enum values lowercase. university_id changed from ObjectId to string fp2. admission_type lowercase with round_based added.

_id.description: Primary key. Always identical to fp2. Format: '{country_code3}|{state}|{city}|{university_name_clean}|{name_clean}|{program_type}'. e.g. 'usa|california|stanford|stanford university|bachelor of arts in psychology|bachelors'. All segments lowercase. Use '_' as placeholder when state or city is unknown. Set explicitly by pipeline — NOT MongoDB auto-generated. Collision = exact duplicate → merge only.

fp2.description: Location-based dedup fingerprint. Always identical to _id. First 4 pipe-separated segments always match universityId exactly. P3 integrity check: every record must satisfy (_id == fp2).

fp1.description: Domain-based stable fingerprint. Format: '{country_code3}|{domain_clean}|{university_name_clean}|{name_clean}|{program_type}'. Written once on insert, never changed. Null when university domain unknown.

name.description: Full standard English program name. No abbreviations ever. min_length=2. e.g. 'Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering'. Proper case for display. Higher-tier source wins on merge.

name_clean.description: Output of clean_string(name). Lowercase, diacritics stripped, punctuation stripped. Used for ALL Jaccard dedup comparisons. See CORE_RULES.md Section 4 for clean_string() spec.

name_original.description: Native script program name for non-English programs. Stored for traceability.

university_id.description: fp2 string reference to the universities collection _id. e.g. 'usa|california|stanford|stanford university'. Must exist — no orphan programs allowed (P1 check). Updated when university merges occur (cascade).

university_name.description: Full canonical English name of the offering university. Denormalized from university record. Keep in sync via pipeline.

university_website.description: Official root domain of the university. Denormalized from university record. Null when university has no website.

university_type.description: Institution type from parent university. Denormalized for filtering. ALL values lowercase.

country.description: Full English country name. e.g. 'United States'. NOT ISO code. Denormalized from university location.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code lowercase. e.g. 'us', 'in', 'gb'.

state.description: Full state/province name. No abbreviations. Denormalized from university location.

city.description: City name. From city alias map. Denormalized from university location.

program_type.description: Degree level. ALL values lowercase — no exceptions. Classification cascade: direct source map → keyword rules → AI.

program_category.description: High-level category overlay. ALL values lowercase.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier. All lowercase kebab-case. Generated once on insert, never changed.

aliases.description: Alternative names, acronyms, variant spellings from merged sources. Up to 15 entries. Merged with $addToSet.

program_description.description: Full program description. Plain text, no HTML. Higher-tier source preferred.

program_profile.description: Shorter program overview. Highlights and USP.

duration_in_years.description: Program length in years. e.g. 2.0, 1.5, 4.0. NOT in fingerprint. Convert months to years (divide by 12). Null only when source provides no duration.

mode.description: Mode of study. ALL values lowercase with underscores. NOT in fingerprint. Default: array on single record when same program has multiple modes. Split into separate records only when single portal lists as separate programs with different fees/curriculum.

specialization_areas.description: Specific tracks within the program. e.g. ['Robotics', 'Energy Systems'].

admission_type.description: Admissions pattern. ALL values lowercase. round_based added in v4.

application_start_date.description: Date applications open. Format: 'DD MM YYYY'.

application_deadline.description: Application deadline. Format: 'DD MM YYYY'. 'rolling' for rolling. 'round 1: DD MM YYYY; round 2: DD MM YYYY' for round-based.

start_date.description: Program start date. Format: 'DD-MM-YYYY' or 'month yyyy'. 'rolling' if multiple.

application_fee.description: Program-specific application fee in native currency.

application_fee_usd.description: Application fee converted to USD. Auto-computed.

program_fees_domestic.description: Annual domestic tuition in native currency.

program_fees_currency.description: ISO 4217 code for domestic fees. Uppercase.

program_fees_domestic_usd.description: Annual domestic tuition converted to USD. Auto-computed.

program_fees_international.description: Annual international tuition in native currency.

program_fees_international_currency.description: ISO 4217 code for international fees. Uppercase.

program_fees_international_usd.description: Annual international tuition converted to USD. Auto-computed.

program_ranking.description: Legacy flat ranking string. Keep for backward compatibility.

program_ranking_rank.description: Exact program rank. Number or range only.

test_scores.description: Required or accepted test scores. One item per test.

testname.description: Test name. e.g. 'IELTS', 'TOEFL iBT', 'GRE General Test'.

required_for.description: Who must submit. ALL values lowercase.

admission_requirements.description: Structured admission requirements by student type.

special_quota_countries.description: Country/bloc quotas at program level. Overrides university-level.

backlogs_accepted.description: Whether backlogs accepted. e.g. 'no', 'max 2 backlogs'. Lowercase.

language_test_waiver.description: Waiver conditions. 'na' if no waiver. Lowercase.

optional_test_combinations.description: Groups where student picks ONE test from each group.

letter_of_recommendations.description: LORs required. e.g. '3', '2'. '0' if not required.

statement_of_purpose.description: SOP requirement. e.g. 'required', '1'. '0' if not required. Lowercase.

work_experience_required_years.description: Required experience in years. 0 if not required.

lastSeenAt.description: Last portal refresh timestamp. Updated on every insert, update, or merge. Staleness policy: 0-12mo = active, 12-24mo = stale (flag), 24+mo = ghost candidate (review). Programs NEVER auto-deleted.

sources.description: Complete source attribution. One entry per portal. Min 1 entry at lock time.

source_name.description: Portal identifier lowercase. e.g. 'ipeds-completions-2024', 'studyportals'. Never duplicate within one record.

source_tier.description: Tier 1-5 per Source Priority Ladder. See CORE_RULES.md Section 3.

source_data_date.description: Source's data freshness date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

captured_data.description: ALL raw fields from this source as flat dict. Schema fields use field name as key (e.g. 'program_fees_domestic': '52000'). Non-schema fields use '_source.' prefix (e.g. '_source.award_level_code': '5'). Nothing discarded. CHANGED in v4: was List[dict], now flat dict matching university schema format.

translated.description: True if AI translated to English. Default false.

degree_name.description: Raw degree abbreviation from source. e.g. 'B.Sc.', 'M.S.'.

subject_area.description: Broad subject discipline label from portal.

earnings_1yr_median.description: Median earnings 1 year post-completion. GOVT_ONLY — Tier 5 cannot write.

earnings_4yr_median_national.description: National median for this CIP at 4 years. GOVT_ONLY.

debt_median.description: Median student debt at graduation. GOVT_ONLY.

ipeds_completions_count.description: Completion count for this CIP at this institution. GOVT_ONLY.

data_completeness_score.description: Weighted completeness score 0.0-1.0. See CORE_RULES.md for field registry and weights.

_REQUIRED_AT_LOCK: _id (fp2), fp1, name, name_clean, university_id, university_name, university_website, country, state, city, program_type, duration_in_years, slug, lastSeenAt, sources (min 1 entry)
_FP2_FORMULA: _id == fp2 == '{country_code3}|{state}|{city}|{university_name_clean}|{name_clean}|{program_type}' — all lowercase, use '_' for unknown
_GOVT_ONLY_FIELDS: earnings_1yr_median, earnings_4yr_median, earnings_5yr_median, earnings_4yr_median_national, debt_median, ipeds_completions_count — Tier 5 aggregators can NEVER write to these even when empty
_NO_ABBREVIATIONS: name and name_clean NEVER contain abbreviations. 'BA' → 'Bachelor of Arts'. No exceptions.
_ALL_LOWERCASE_ENUMS: program_type, mode, admission_type, program_category, test_type, requirements, required_for — ALL lowercase. No Title Case.
_SCHEMA_CHANGES_v4: 1. mode values: Full-time→full_time, Part-time→part_time, Online→online, Hybrid→hybrid. 2. captured_data changed from List[dict] to flat dict. 3. university_id from ObjectId to string fp2. 4. admission_type lowercase + round_based. 5. All enum values lowercase. 6. test_scores.requirements lowercase (Required→required). 7. source_tier description aligned with Core Rules v8.
